items.topic: How to sell streetwear sneakers online
items.content:
Here are **10 high-retention viral hooks** engineered to stop the scroll, crush the 3-second drop-off, and build instant authority in the sneaker e-commerce space.

---

### 🔍 Curiosity Gap Hooks
*Make them feel like an elite inner circle is keeping secrets from them.*

* **“The secret sneaker suppliers top resellers don’t want you to ever find.”** *(12 words)*
* **“The exact reason your kicks sit for weeks without a single buyer.”** *(12 words)*

---

### ⚠️ Negative / Warning Hooks
*Trigger risk aversion—people will act faster to avoid losing money than to make it.*

* **“Stop buying Jordans to flip until you fix this fatal profit mistake.”** *(12 words)*
* **“Never list a pair of sneakers online until you do this first.”** *(12 words)*

---

### 🔥 Contrarian / Hot Take Hooks
*Call out common industry advice to spark debate in the comments.*

* **“Sneaker reselling isn’t dead. You’re just buying the wrong hype drops.”** *(11 words)*
* **“Bots won’t make you rich reselling kicks. They’re actually draining your cash.”** *(12 words)*

---

### 📖 Story Hooks
*Build rapid trust by showing high-stakes struggle turned into success.*

* **“I was broke with three shoe boxes. Now I flip $10k monthly.”** *(12 words)*
* **“I lost $800 on fake Dunks before discovering this six-figure blueprint.”** *(11 words)*

---

### ⚡ Fast-Result / Secret Hack Hooks
*Promise an instant, low-effort win that viewers can test today.*

* **“This 30-second listing trick will sell your deadstock pairs by tonight.”** *(11 words)*
* **“Use this hidden search filter right now to find massively underpriced kicks.”** *(12 words)*

---

### 💡 Creator Pro-Tip for Execution:
* **First Frame:** Hold up an iconic sneaker (e.g., Jordan 1 or Travis Scott) directly into the lens or aggressively pack a shipping box to match the energy of the hook.
* **On-Screen Text:** Never match your text-on-screen word-for-word with your audio. Use a shortened, punchy visual anchor like **“NEVER DO THIS ❌”** while saying the warning hook out loud.

items.title: How to scale your small business with zero ads in 2026
items.content:

🎬 SCENE 1 (Visual: Creator pointing at smartphone with dashboard):
"Look at this. Over 70% of high-converting sales now come from short-form videos showing behind-the-scenes authenticity, not fancy studio commercials."

🎬 SCENE 2 (Visual: Quick cuts of packaging an order and customer unboxing):

Step 2: Show your actual process—the hustle, packaging the parcel, answering customer DMs.
